step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier with a tail current source and PMOS active/linear loads. It is typically used as a Current Mode Logic (CML) clock buffer to amplify and distribute high-speed differential clock signals with low jitter.

paper_reference.title: A 16-bit 65-MS/s 3.3-V Pipeline ADC Core in SiGe BiCMOS With 78-dB SNR and 180-fs Jitter

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the buffer

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current Id = 0.5 * un*Cox * (W/L) * (Vgs-Vth)^2 = 0.5 * 270u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 = 311 uA. Power = 1.8V * 311uA = 560 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the tail current source bias of 0.9V and SKY130 NMOS parameters at 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/(Vgs-Vth) = 2*155u/0.33 = 0.94 mA/V. Rload (PMOS in linear region with N0=0V) = 1 / (up*Cox * W/L * (Vsg-|Vth|)) = 1 / (50u * 10 * 1.38) = 1.45 kOhm. Gain = gm * Rload = 1.36 V/V = 2.7 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the bias voltage N0. Assuming N0=0V for linear region PMOS loads, the gain is relatively low, which is typical for fast CML buffers.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2*pi*Rload*Cload). Assuming 10fF load + 20fF parasitics = 30fF. BW = 1 / (2*pi*1.45k*30f) = 3.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High bandwidth is required to support the fast clock edges and minimize jitter (180 fs reported in paper).

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from input crossing 0V to output crossing 0V

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay is roughly 0.69 * Rload * Cload = 0.69 * 1.45k * 30f = 30 ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast CML buffers typically have delays in the tens of picoseconds to maintain clock integrity.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient delay of the differential clock buffer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Clock Buffer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VN0 N0 0 0

* Input signals (Common mode 0.9V, Differential AC=1V, Tran=400mVpp)
VCM VCM 0 0.9
VIN_DIFF VIN_DIFF 0 dc 0 ac 1 pulse(-0.2 0.2 0 50p 50p 450p 1n)
E1 CKIN_PLUS VCM VIN_DIFF 0 0.5
E2 CKIN_MINUS VCM VIN_DIFF 0 -0.5

* Load capacitance
C1 CKOUT_PLUS 0 10f
C2 CKOUT_MINUS 0 10f

* VCVS to convert differential output to single-ended for measurement
E_OUT VOUT_DIFF 0 CKOUT_PLUS CKOUT_MINUS 1

* DUT
XM1 CKOUT_MINUS CKIN_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_1 VSS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 CKOUT_PLUS CKIN_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 CKOUT_MINUS N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 CKOUT_PLUS N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 5n
meas tran v_swing_max max v(VOUT_DIFF) from=2n to=5n
meas tran v_swing_min min v(VOUT_DIFF) from=2n to=5n
meas tran t_delay trig v(VIN_DIFF) val=0 rise=3 targ v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0 rise=3
meas tran t_rise trig v(VOUT_DIFF) val=-0.1 rise=3 targ v(VOUT_DIFF) val=0.1 rise=3

quit
.endc
.end
